linkedin:
DNS, the Domain Name System, is the internet's phone book.

It turns a name like example.com into the IP address of the server behind it. When you load a site, a resolver walks from the root servers down to the domain's authoritative server, fetches that IP, caches it briefly, and your browser connects.
